label: P1 SV
notes: The Upgrades tab bundles this set for a hunter whose Survival tree has the most talent points (ticket 803); fallback.ep-weights.json (P1 BM) serves every other hunter.
At this pin P1_SV_EP_PRESET has the same numbers as P1_BM_EP_PRESET; this file keeps its own source so that ep-presets:check catches the day upstream changes one and not the other.
data/presets/ep-weights-by-phase.json and this repo's CLI do not read this file.
